title: Publish a new version automatically after a merge that changes the app
summary: After a merge to main that changes the app and passes CI, a workflow works out the next version, builds both installers on a draft release and publishes it only if both builds pass; merges that touch only docs, agent rules or the site publish nothing.
friction: The CLAUDE.md rule that the account has no Actions minutes is out of date since the repository went public: the dev agent read it and reported that automatic releases could not run, and the claim reached the pull request body and cost a review finding
lessons_learned: A workflow step on a Windows runner with no shell set runs under PowerShell, so a failing command can end the step green: set bash with pipefail for the whole workflow
git diff --name-only hides a file moved out of a watched folder and quotes non-ASCII names: use --no-renames -z when the answer decides something

deferred.what: The draft, build and publish path of the automatic release has never run on GitHub; a mistake there first shows on the first app merge, as a red run with nothing offered to users
deferred.why: It can only run from main, after merge
